baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath coordinates night with the relative clause 'what it gathered'; night supplies a dark temporal field and the verb supplies active collection.
baseline_models.mechanism: Night functions as an envelope whose covering action draws dispersed beings, motions, and concerns into one held domain.

activation_trace.role: Night as darkness opposite day supplies the enclosing temporal field.
Joining dispersed things supplies the field's active collecting operation.

changed_reading.before: An oath by night and whatever happens to lie within it.
changed_reading.after: An oath by night as an active collecting envelope and by the dispersed plurality it compacts into one domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The load-bearing branch of the focus verb allows the relative pronoun to name a burden, fruit, or latent yield carried by night.
baseline_models.mechanism: Night is not merely a container around contents; it bears an accumulating payload through a concealed interval.

activation_trace.role: The dark night supplies the concealed interval in which a payload can be borne.
Physical bearing, including water, offspring, and fruit, turns gathered contents into a carried load with latent yield.

changed_reading.before: Night hides a set of already formed things.
changed_reading.after: Night bears a still-forming load whose weight or yield accumulates while concealed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb can move from joining parts to their even, completed arrangement, although that completion image is form-distant from the transitive surface here.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gathering is read as a process with a telos: dispersed material is not only co-located but brought toward coherence and fullness.

activation_trace.role: The bounded night period supplies the interval across which completion can develop.
Orderly, even completion supplies the endpoint latent inside the act of gathering.

changed_reading.before: Night simply puts separate contents together.
changed_reading.after: Night draws what it takes in toward an ordered and completed configuration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventories pair activity or travel by night with a group kept together while being driven.
baseline_models.mechanism: Night acts as a conductor of motion, holding multiple travelers or states together as one moving cohort rather than one stationary heap.

activation_trace.role: Entering, acting, or traveling by night supplies nocturnal movement.
A driven group held together supplies the moving-cohort mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Night conducts what it gathers as a held-together nocturnal convoy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A focus branch names a standard load-measure, allowing the gathered object to be heard as a total made measurable.
baseline_models.mechanism: Collection converts indefinite plurality into one bounded load or quota; the reading is metrological rather than merely spatial.

activation_trace.role: The night period bounds the interval over which the total is accumulated.
A standard load-measure supplies the conversion from gathered multiplicity to a reckoned total.

changed_reading.after: Night gathers its contents into a bounded, assessable load.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sky and the earth's casting out and becoming empty reverse the focus action. Nightly gathering is therefore one phase of a larger intake-and-release cycle rather than permanent enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed contents supplies the intake phase that the earlier cosmic scenes reverse.
Splitting and opening supplies the breach of a previously enclosing cosmic body.
Casting an object out supplies the outward transfer opposite nocturnal collection.
A place becoming bare or empty supplies the completed release state.

structural_cues: 84:1-4 presents enclosing bodies opening and emptying before 84:17 names nocturnal gathering.
The repeated indefinite 'what' in 84:4 and 84:17 leaves the payload unnamed while reversing its direction of travel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, casting, emptying, and gathering; I infer a reversible container cycle linking them. A live alternative is that the scenes are parallel oath images with no shared payload or causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: Night statically keeps whatever enters its darkness.
changed_reading.after: Night is the intake phase of a cosmic containment cycle, gathering dispersed contents that an opened container can later disclose and discharge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wearisome striving generates distributed traces; the book joins them into a registered body, and accounting counts that body. The focus gathering becomes moral and documentary compression as well as nocturnal enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed units supplies the consolidation of many acts into one record.
Bearing a load supplies the accumulated weight of the consolidated record.
Strenuous work supplies the repeated units accumulated by the focus gathering.
A scratch or bite mark supplies the image of toil leaving durable traces.
Entering a name into a register supplies documentary consolidation and attribution.
Counting and reckoning supply the operation performed on the gathered total.

structural_cues: 84:6-8 runs from doubled striving, to receipt of a book, to reckoning.
The focus arrives after both outcomes of book reception have been displayed, so gathering can retain both favorable and adverse totals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies toil, trace-like damage, registration, reckoning, and load-bearing collection; I infer that scattered acts become the record's carried total. A live alternative is that night gathers creatures only, while the accounting sequence remains a separate human scene.

changed_reading.before: Night gathers external beings and movements.
changed_reading.after: Night also compacts dispersed exertions and their marks into the load-like total that can be registered and reckoned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath sequence moves from sunset's red remainder, through night actively collecting, to the moon becoming evenly complete. The repeated root presents collection and completed coherence as adjacent phases.

activation_trace.role: Night as the dark counterpart to day supplies the middle temporal field in the oath sequence.
Active joining of dispersed contents supplies the process phase.
The red afterglow at sunset supplies the threshold from day into the collecting night.
The moon and its light supply a visible body on which completion can appear.
Becoming even, ordered, and full supplies the visible completion phase after collection.

structural_cues: 84:16-18 is one uninterrupted three-part oath sequence.
The same root shifts from a transitive focus form with an object to the moon's intransitive completed state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent temporal sequence and the same root in collection and completion branches; I infer a process-to-result analogy, not that night physically causes lunar fullness. A live alternative is that the two root uses are juxtaposed but semantically independent.

changed_reading.before: Night's collection and the full moon are separate oath objects.
changed_reading.after: The pair displays one morphology of coherence: night gathers dispersed contents, and the moon makes gathered order visibly full.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus image of a driven group is immediately followed by riding or bearing an affair through state after state. What night gathers can therefore be a cohort undergoing serial transition, not a collection at rest.

activation_trace.role: A group driven while held together supplies the convoy carried into the next image.
Undertaking and bearing an affair supplies passage rather than static occupancy.
One state after another supplies the convoy's serial route.
Superposed layers supply a spatial model for successive conditions.

structural_cues: 84:17-19 places gathering, completed lunar order, and compelled passage through layers in direct succession.
The gathered object remains indefinite, allowing the next verse's addressed travelers to fill the cohort role without exhausting it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a held-together driven group followed by riding and successive layers; I infer that adjacency turns the gathered plurality into a traveling cohort. A live alternative is that 84:19 addresses human transitions independently of the night image.

changed_reading.before: Night gathers a stationary mass beneath its cover.
changed_reading.after: Night gathers a convoy and holds it together while it is borne through successive layers or conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later clause speaks of what people store, with branches for meanings held in the heart and objects enclosed in a vessel. Its repeated indefinite object turns the focus collection inward: night can gather containers whose concealed payload is itself gathered and known.

activation_trace.role: Darkness supplies concealment without implying that the concealed payload is unknowable.
Joining dispersed contents supplies the outer collection mirrored inside human vessels.
A thing becoming disclosed to a knower prevents darkness from functioning as epistemic erasure.
Holding meanings in the heart supplies an inward payload for the focus collection.
Enclosing an object in a vessel supplies nested containment: gathered persons remain gatherers within themselves.

structural_cues: 84:17 and 84:23 both use an indefinite 'what' as the object of a collecting or storing action.
Night's darkness and the later assertion of superior knowledge create concealment without loss of access.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer gathering, inward storage, and knowledge of the stored object; I infer a nested-container relation in which night gathers persons together with what they hold inwardly. A live alternative is that the two indefinite-object clauses have unrelated domains.

changed_reading.before: What night gathers consists only of externally visible beings and events.
changed_reading.after: Night gathers nested vessels: outward lives together with the meanings and contents they silently store.

context_deltas.mechanism: Several side branches form a measurement network: a small capacity measure, counting, division into shares, and a weighed amount. They activate the focus load-measure so gathering becomes conversion of plurality into an assessable allotment.

activation_trace.role: A standard load-measure supplies the central metrological image.
A smaller capacity measure supplies a second scale within the packet's measurement field.
Counting and reckoning supply the operation that evaluates a bounded load.
Separating a share and dividing a whole supply allocation after aggregation.
A named weighed amount supplies a terminal weight-image alongside the focus load-measure.

structural_cues: Measurement images recur from the earth scene through accounting, oath, focus gathering, and final recompense language.
The focus verb stands at the point where dispersed contents can become one load before the passage speaks of successive states and outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several non-dominant measure and allotment branches plus explicit reckoning; I infer that their recurrence activates a metrological frame around the focus verb. A live alternative is that these are unrelated lexical side branches and only the ordinary gathering sense is operative.

changed_reading.before: Night gathers an indefinite multitude without evaluating it.
changed_reading.after: Night converts dispersed contents into a load-like allotment that can be counted, divided, and weighed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a reproductive side branch under the later recitation root. It remains anchored because the focus load-bearing branch explicitly includes carrying offspring and fruit, while the earlier earth scene supplies casting and emptying. Downstream prose should present it only as a gestational material analogy, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb's bearing branch lets night hold a developing yield rather than merely conceal finished contents.

activation_trace.role: Bearing offspring or fruit supplies gestation and ripening within the focus action.
A womb collecting a pregnancy sharpens the image of gathered material developing inside a bearer.
Casting out supplies emergence from the prior bearing state.
The emptied container supplies the state after its latent load has emerged.

changed_reading.before: Night is a dark warehouse for completed objects.
changed_reading.after: Night is tentatively a gestational bearer: it gathers a load, develops its yield in concealment, and stands in a larger rhythm of emergence and emptying.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries physical collection into cognition and bodily posture. It remains valid as an activation because the focus collection branch includes the coming-together of an affair or mind, while later branches supply divided attention, gathered recitation, and lowering of the body. Downstream prose should mark it as a cross-domain diagnostic analogy, not claim that the verse directly denotes recitation or prostration.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus gathering can include the mind's coming together, so 'what night gathers' may test whether collected meaning becomes coherent response.

activation_trace.role: Joining scattered things, affairs, or attention supplies cognitive integration anchored in the focus verb.
A mind divided among several aspects supplies the disintegrated state that gathering could reverse.
Collection and coming together supply recitation as an assembly of meanings.
Reading and reciting locate that gathered meaning in the later audible event.
Bodily lowering supplies the embodied coherence that the hearers withhold.

changed_reading.before: Night's gathering is a neutral physical fact.
changed_reading.after: Night's gathered coherence becomes an exploratory foil: meanings may be assembled and heard while the human body still refuses to gather itself into responsive submission.

strongest_changes: The early opening and emptying scenes revise night from a static cover into the intake phase of a reversible cosmic containment cycle.
The toil-book-account sequence turns gathered nocturnal contents into accumulated traces compacted as a carried and reckonable total.
The repeated focus root in the moon verse makes gathering and ordered fullness adjacent process and result images.
The later inward-storage clause nests concealed meanings inside the persons and events that night gathers.
summary.what_was_special: The packet kept several live mechanisms apart: enclosure, burden-bearing, completion, convoy movement, accounting, metrology, inward storage, and gestation. The most productive activation was the same root moving from transitive collection in 84:17 to visible lunar completion in 84:18, while remote branch images exposed additional load, measure, and womb-like structures without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The process-to-result link between nocturnal gathering and lunar fullness may be analogical rather than sequential.
The convoy reading depends on a distant driven-group branch and on treating immediate adjacency as activation.
The metrological network may reflect coincident side branches rather than a sustained measurement mechanism.
The gestational and cognition-to-posture readings require explicit exploratory qualification because their context triggers are cross-domain.
